title: Greek Saganaki Bites with Cobnut Crunch
description: A twist on the classic Greek saganaki, these bite-sized treats feature crunchy cobnut topping and oozy feta.
instructions: 2. Slice the Greek bread into 1-inch cubes.
3. In a bowl, mix together crumbled feta cheese, olive oil, and cinnamon.
4. Add the chopped cobnuts to the feta mixture and stir to combine.
5. Stuff each bread cube with a small piece of oozy saganaki cheese.
6. Roll the bread cubes in the feta-cobnut mixture to coat.
7. Place the coated bread cubes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
8. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the bread is toasted and the cheese is melted.
